purpose: Stage and independently review only inert literal-path pinned inode identity primitives beneath an already-open conversion-root directory FD for future Local Mistral conversion evidence verification.
requiredInvariants: This PR is inert and stages only pinned filesystem identity. It does not establish content trust, owner/mode trust, immutable bytes, size authority, hashes, conversion-root authority, report/model/server semantics, model invocation, evidence publication, provider status or workflow activation.

The caller supplies an already-open conversion-root directory FD. This segment only verifies that the supplied FD currently refers to a directory; discovery and authorization of that root are deferred to a later separately reviewed segment.
This segment never opens '/', never walks /srv/tai-models/conversion-runs and never derives exact-main/run/attempt filesystem paths.

Only compile-time literal child directories evidence, artifacts, toolchain and bin are admissible beneath the supplied root; directory identities are opened with O_PATH, O_DIRECTORY, O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC.

Only the three exact authority-relative literals for conversion report, Mistral GGUF and llama-server are admissible, and those authority strings are equality checks only and are never supplied to os.open.

Only the three compile-time literal final filenames conversion-report.json, mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3-q4-k-m.gguf and llama-server are admissible; each final identity is opened with O_PATH, O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC and must fstat as a regular file.

A successful result is only a still-open O_PATH-pinned regular-file identity plus stable device/inode identity. It deliberately exposes no size, uid, mode or content authority and cannot read file bytes through the returned FD.

Pathname replacement after a successful O_PATH open cannot retarget the already-open identity FD. In-place byte mutation is intentionally outside this segment because no bytes or mutable metadata are consumed or trusted here.

The later content-verification segment must independently reopen or snapshot from the pinned identity, revalidate permissions and mutable metadata at consumption time, and prove exact content identity/hash before any semantic or execution authority is granted.
All fail-closed ConversionEvidenceError raises suppress chained operating-system exception context and expose only fixed internal error codes.
No product, API, database, RBAC, registration, cabinet, customer-data or production-routing behavior is activated.
Local Qwen is the independent reviewer because this changes future Local Mistral authority only.
REG.RU remains production authority and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
